dct_description_sm:
The Capital Budget & Forecast Road Line items represent the various 
road improvement and sidewalk construction locations found throughout 
the city. These projects have all been identified in the capital budget 
and scheduled from the current year until 10 years later. The items from
 year 2-10 are part of the capital forecast and could be subject to 
change as priority setting and budget funding levels change.
